description: Server modules that decode their own commands before the server's Command enum sees the line (p05-ipc queue Q2). check-spec-inventory.py reads the names and the authority; check-sdk-schema.py reads the request fields. enum: the module's #[serde(tag = "cmd")] enum, each variant named with #[serde(rename = "...")]. envelope: the struct that flattens the enum; its other fields (minus the reply id) every variant accepts. enum_handler: the function that dispatches the enum. A module that matches its commands only by name has none of the three. literals: commands the module matches by name, with their handler, their request struct (or the list of structs whose fields make up the request; a struct in another server file is "path/under/server.rs::Name") and fields: the members the handler reads from the raw line instead, each {type: the Rust type it accepts, Option<T> when it takes null; presence: required or optional}; the handler's tests cover each refusal. refused_envelope_fields: envelope fields a command's handler refuses before decoding. authority: the profile of every command; local-admin needs the non-Unix refusal in enum_handler and in every literal handler.
